Across three independent enrichment paradigms — RaMP multi-DB ORA, Mummichog m/z-directed activity scoring, and MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA — the top consensus hit is Methionine Metabolism (KEGG:map00270 / hsa00270), which achieved the strongest cross-tool score (FDR=1.19e-13 in RaMP; p=3.36e-07 in MetaboAnalystR; p=0.0187 in Mummichog). The WikiPathways Methionine de novo and salvage pathway (WP:WP3580, FDR=1.16e-13) corroborates the same network. Driver metabolites verified from enrichment rosters include homocysteine (KEGG:C00155), S-adenosylmethionine (KEGG:C00019), L-methionine (KEGG:C00073), adenosine (KEGG:C00212), choline (KEGG:C00114), L-glutamic acid (KEGG:C00025), and cysteic acid (KEGG:C00506), spanning the methionine cycle, transsulfuration, and folate one-carbon pathways. react_result.final_narrative_text: Three complementary enrichment paradigms identified consistent perturbation of one-carbon metabolism. RaMP multi-database ORA returned KEGG:hsa00670 (One carbon pool by folate, FDR=3.36e-07) as the top KEGG hit, with five input metabolites (homocysteine, methionine, S-adenosylmethionine, choline, adenosine) mapping to this pathway. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed this result at the same rank (p=3.36e-07) with the identical compound roster. RaMP ORA further identified KEGG:map00270 (Methionine Metabolism, FDR=1.19e-13) and KEGG:map00260 (Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism, FDR=3.75e-19) as top-5 hits, while Mummichog m/z-directed activity scored glycine/serine/threonine metabolism and methionine/cysteine metabolism at p=0.022. The cross-paradigm consensus across ORA, m/z-direct, and network-based enrichment implicates S-adenosylmethionine and homocysteine as driver metabolites in the folate-mediated one-carbon pool. L-Threonine additionally implicates glycine-serine-threonine metabolism as a secondary affected node.

The WikiPathways Methionine de novo and salvage pathway (WP:WP3580, FDR=1.16e-13) corroborates the same network. Driver metabolites verified from enrichment rosters include homocysteine (KEGG:C00155), S-adenosylmethionine (KEGG:C00019), L-methionine (KEGG:C00073), adenosine (KEGG:C00212), choline (KEGG:C00114), L-glutamic acid (KEGG:C00025), and cysteic acid (KEGG:C00506), spanning the methionine cycle, transsulfuration, and folate one-carbon pathways.
